problem:
Express the triple integral 

$$
{∭}_{R}{x}^{2}+xy+{z}^{2}\,\text{d}V
$$

over the box

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,-1\le x\le 3,\,1\le y\le 4,\,0\le z\le 5}
$$

as a repeated integral of the form 

$$
{\int }_{a}^{b}{\int }_{c}^{d}{\int }_{e}^{f}…\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z.
$$
worked_solution:
Given the limits for $x,y,$ and $z,$ we can express our triple integral as a repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}{x}^{2}+xy+{z}^{2}\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{0}^{5}{\int }_{-1}^{3}{\int }_{1}^{4}{x}^{2}+xy+{z}^{2}\,\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z\end{aligned}
$$
